channels_thread_parent_check.name: channels_thread_parent_check
channels_thread_parent_check.value:
("channels"."type" = 'thread' and "channels"."parent_id" is not null and "channels"."parent_message_id" is not null)
    or ("channels"."type" <> 'thread' and "channels"."parent_id" is null and "channels"."parent_message_id" is null)

users_active_role_check.name: users_active_role_check
users_active_role_check.value: "users"."status" <> 'active' or ("users"."role_id" is not null and "users"."joined_at" is not null)
